前景乾淨、主體清楚、背景失焦。場景寫「有什麼」而不是「沒有什麼」：例如「草地與小徑空無一人」。

一個有名字的表情加視線，是一個靜止的瞬間；不寫「先……再……」這種需要時間的變化。
每張只有一個主要姿態：重心在哪隻腳、兩手各放哪裡；手部安排簡單，不疊加多個動作。
他拍、全片幅相機、指定焦段與距離；不寫手機前鏡頭、不寫自拍。

sets.prompt: A 22-year-old adult Taiwanese woman with her natural fair skin tone, a round sweet face with large bright double-eyelid eyes and full lips, black silky straight hair worn down past her shoulders. Petite curvy figure, 162 cm tall, bust 87 cm, waist 58 cm, hips 90 cm, D cup, a full chest, a slim waist and rounded hips. She wears a fitted dusty-beige ribbed knit tube top and a matching high-waisted knit mini skirt, beige strappy platform sandals and a thin gold chain necklace. Setting: an old red-brick arcade walkway on a historic Taipei shopping street in the afternoon, a row of arched brick pillars, closed wooden shopfront doors, the walkway empty and clean. She stands beside one of the brick pillars, one hand resting lightly on the pillar at shoulder height and the other on her hip, smiling warmly. Shot: a full-length shot, from a little above her head to just below her feet, both feet whole, showing the knit tube top, the high-waisted knit mini skirt, her legs and the platform sandals, one hand on the pillar and the other on her hip. Body: standing with her weight on her left leg and her right knee softly bent, her body square to the camera, shoulders level and relaxed, her hips shifted slightly with her weight. Face and gaze: her face toward the camera, looking into the camera. Camera: horizontal 16:9 frame, full-frame camera with a 50mm lens from about 4.7 metres, camera at her hip height, level, natural perspective without distortion; she fills about 87% of the frame height. Composition: she stands at the left third beside a brick pillar, the row of arches and closed wooden shopfronts receding behind her to the right in one-point perspective. Emphasis: the full proportion of the knit set and her legs, and her place in the old arcade street, with her smile clear. Lighting: warm afternoon sunlight enters from the open side of the arcade and lays soft shafts of light across the floor and her body; a large white reflector just out of frame fills her face evenly; warm brick, beige and soft grey tones. Natural skin texture with visible pores, unretouched, crisp focus on her eyes, fine fabric detail, natural colour grading, a professional fashion editorial photograph.

Emphasis: the oblique seated pose shows the curve of her full chest and slim waist, and the three-quarter face toward the window light carries her quiet, dreamy mood. Natural skin texture with visible pores, unretouched, crisp focus on her eyes, fine fabric detail, natural colour grading, a professional fashion editorial photograph.

裁切不落在關節：膝上切在膝蓋下方的小腿上段；大腿中段以上切在膝蓋上方很遠；腰上切在腰線下方、臀部上方；胸上切在胸線下方、手肘上方。所有景別都保留完整髮頂。
